title: Sphinx Warriors guard the desert
changes: New monster in the Sunscar: the Sphinx Warrior, a lion-headed tomb guardian in a striped gold-and-blue headcloth, with golden wings, a curved blade and a shield
Sphinx Warriors guard buried Kharsun, Mirage Wells and the Thornspire Heights (Lv 36-46)
Watch for their leap: they spread their wings and drop onto you, knocking back everyone nearby
